story: AWS releases a free AWS Emulator, built entirely by AI agents, that runs more than 200 cloud services locally

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: A free copy of AWS, on your machine
segments.narration: AWS released a free cloud copy that runs offline on your machine.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: AWS Emulator: 200+ services, all AI-built
segments.narration: The AWS Emulator simulates over two hundred services. AI agents wrote and tested every line.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Agents build against fidelity tests
segments.narration: Agents build against fidelity tests checked on real AWS. Security agents review every change.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: Test cloud apps offline, for free
segments.narration: You could test cloud apps offline, for free. The catch: it's a simulation, so verify on real AWS.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Try it on a test project first
segments.narration: Our take: ask your developer to try it on a test project first.
